listing.name: Cyber Troopers Virtual-On — virtualon_pc (drakenabarion)
listing.summary: Experimental project. The project reports original VirtualOn omg boot, menus, matches and audio. Online play is unavailable. Full-game compatibility has not been established, and Portcove has not confirmed this component. See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PS4 VirtualOnMasterpiece CUSA16156 decrypted collection folder with eboot.bin,pjv3.elf,sce_module,sce_sys and assets. Select original VirtualOn component omg, not ot/force. Exact update/digests unbound.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Use Virtual-On-x86_64.AppImage or the Windows ZIP, or build with build.sh. Select your own folder and the omg component in the launcher (or BB_EXE=omg). This is the collection’s shared native runtime.

warnings: The project reports original VirtualOn omg boot, menus, matches and audio. Online play is unavailable. Full-game compatibility has not been established, and Portcove has not confirmed this component.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
